data.title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
data.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
  • Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
  • Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
  • Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
  • Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator
  • Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
  • Du wertest Kundenfeedback systematisch aus (Surveys, Reviews, Retourengründe) und bringst die Erkenntnisse ins Produktteam und in die Kampagnen
  • Du konzipierst Angebote und Bundles mit und rechnest sie durch – auf Deckungsbeitrag, nicht nur auf Conversion
  • Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  


Dein Profil

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Product Marketing, Brand Management oder Growth – idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand oder im E-Commerce
  • Du hast schon Produktlaunches verantwortet und kannst konkret sagen, was dabei rausgekommen ist
  • Du schreibst selbst: Positionierungen, Briefings, Landingpage-Copy. Klar und ohne Floskeln
  • Du arbeitest mit Zahlen: Conversion, Deckungsbeitrag, Sell-Through sagen dir etwas
  • Du verstehst, wie Performance-Creative funktioniert und was ein Hook ist 
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Maximaler Einfluss: Product Marketing sitzt bei uns direkt an der Schnittstelle von Produkt, Growth und Founder-Team. Deine Erkenntnisse beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche Produkte wir als Nächstes entwickeln.
  • Keine Marketing-Theorie: Du arbeitest mit echten Kunden, echten Kaufdaten und sehr großen Mengen an Performance- und Creative-Daten und siehst unmittelbar, welche Entscheidungen funktionieren.
  • Extrem schnelle Feedback-Loops: Produkt, Performance Marketing, Creative, CRM und E-Commerce arbeiten eng zusammen. Was du entwickelst, landet nicht Monate später in einer Präsentation, sondern wird getestet.
  • Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du übernimmst keine fertige Product-Marketing-Struktur, sondern kannst Prozesse, Customer-Insights-Systeme und Launch-Mechaniken selbst aufbauen und prägen.
  • Große Reichweite: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst Produkte und Kampagnen für eine Brand mit bereits über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden.
  • Direkter Austausch mit den Foundern: Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Geschwindigkeit und direkter Zugang zu den Personen, die Produkt- und Unternehmensstrategie verantworten.
  • Starkes Performance-Marketing-Umfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit einem datengetriebenen Performance- und Creative-Team zusammen und kannst Produktmarketing unmittelbar mit realem Marktfeedback verbinden.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir wollen nicht, dass du bestehende Prozesse nur ausführst. Wir erwarten, dass du sie hinterfragst und besser machst.
  • Steile Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Pammys wächst weiter in neue Produkte, Kategorien und Märkte. Dein Verantwortungsbereich kann mit diesem Wachstum deutlich größer werden.
  • Unternehmerische Kultur: Wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Entscheidungen treffen und Ergebnisse liefern wollen.

data.title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
data.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Wir machen wenige Modelle in großen Stückzahlen — jeder Millimeter am Leisten, im Fußbett und in der Konstruktion multipliziert sich hunderttausendfach. Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht.
  • Du baust dein Team auf und führst es: Footwear Development, Leisten & Passform (Last & Fit), Tooling, Commercialisation und Materials — in der Reihenfolge, die das Wachstum verlangt.
  • Du etablierst Leisten und Passform als Kernkompetenz: eigene Leisten-Bibliothek, Passform-Standards, Grading — bei Comfort-Schuhen ist der Leisten das Produkt.
  • Du entwickelst unsere eigenen Komfort-Technologien für Fußbett und Sohle — gemeinsam mit starken Material- und Compound-Partnern.
  • Du verankerst Wear-Tests sowie Prüf- und Compliance-Standards (SATRA/ISO, REACH, Produktsicherheit für den EU-Markt) im Entwicklungsprozess.
  • Du arbeitest im festen Dreier-Team mit Produktmanagement und Design: Du machst Entwürfe baubar, ohne sie kleinzumachen.
  • Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sourcing ab — zu Machbarkeit, Werkzeugen und Serienanlauf.


Dein Profil

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in der Footwear-Produktentwicklung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre), davon mehrere Jahre fabrikseitig in Asien — im Sample Room, nicht nur im Videocall.
  • Ideal: Erfahrung mit Comfort-Produkten oder EVA (Spritzguss, Formteile) — alternativ Athletic Footwear mit echter Tooling-Tiefe.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast Entwicklungsteams geführt und einen T&A-Kalender über mehrere Modelle parallel gehalten.
  • Solides Handwerk in FOB-Kalkulation, Tooling-Ökonomie und Materialkunde.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und Reisebereitschaft.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Du baust die technische Produktentwicklung von Grund auf auf: Statt bestehende Strukturen nur zu verwalten, definierst du unsere Standards für Leisten, Passform, Komfort, Tooling und Commercialisation selbst.
  • Echter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Deine Entscheidungen bestimmen unmittelbar, wie unsere Schuhe sitzen, funktionieren und sich im Alltag anfühlen.
  • Große Stückzahlen, große Wirkung: Wir entwickeln bewusst wenige Modelle mit hohem Volumen. Technische Verbesserungen, die du entwickelst, wirken sich direkt auf hunderttausende Produkte aus.
  • Du entwickelst eigene Technologien: Gemeinsam mit starken Partnern entwickelst du eigene Komfortlösungen für Fußbett, Materialien und Sohlenkonstruktionen, statt lediglich bestehende Lösungen einzukaufen.
  • Du stellst dein eigenes Team zusammen: Du entscheidest mit, welche Kompetenzen wir wann intern aufbauen und entwickelst daraus eine leistungsstarke Footwear-Development-Organisation.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Design und Sourcing: Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und keine langen Konzernschleifen zwischen Entwicklung, Design und Produktion.
  • Nähe zu den Foundern: Du arbeitest eng mit den Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und kannst technische Produktentscheidungen direkt auf höchster Ebene beeinflussen.
  • Internationales Produktionsumfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktions-, Material- und Tooling-Partnern in Asien zusammen und bist dort, wo die Produkte tatsächlich entstehen.
  • Hoher Qualitätsanspruch statt schneller Kompromisse: Bei Pammys ist Passform kein Detail. Du bekommst den Raum, Standards aufzubauen, mit denen unsere Produkte technisch und qualitativ langfristig besser werden.
  • Wachstum mit Verantwortung: Mit neuen Modellen, Kategorien und höheren Volumen wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich und damit die Möglichkeit, eine zentrale Produktfunktion bei Pammys langfristig zu prägen.

data.title: Senior Product Manager
Talent Acquisition Manager - German&English speaker (w/m/d)
Product Manager, Search
data.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.

The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.

What you'll work on

  • Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain 
  • Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
  • Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.

Our humble expectations

We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.

  • You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.
  • You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.
  • You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.
  • You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.
  • You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.
  • You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

data.title: Lead Revenue Operations (f/m/d)
data.description:
Your Role

We’re looking for a Lead Revenue Operations (f/m/d) to take ownership of our commercial operations and help drive our revenue engine. You’ll work at the intersection of Sales, Relationship Management, Marketing, Finance, Tech and Product with a clear mission: to build a scalable, data-driven commercial infrastructure that fuels growth and efficiency at LIQID.

What Will Keep You Challenged?

  • Design, implement and continuously improve sales & relationship management processes, funnels, KPIs and reports and own data governance for the revenue organization: a single authoritative definition for every commercial KPI, data quality standards and their enforcement.

  • Act as functional owner of the commercial toolkit incl. CRM (data model, object structure, field logic, workflows, permissions and AI-integration)

  • Drive operational excellence and change through automation and system optimization (CRM, automation, VOIP, BI etc.).

  • Assess funnel performance and attribution jointly with Marketing, including each channel's contribution to closed business, and enable growth initiatives with the data and infrastructure they require.

  • Drive the revenue forecast end to end—methodology, cadence, model maintenance and accountability for forecast accuracy—and turn data into recommendations for the management team: risks, opportunities and trend breaks, with a clear point of view.

  • Design and maintain how targets and client portfolios are allocated across the commercial team—customer segmentation, coverage segments, assignment rules and individual targets—and create transparency on existing-client economics: churn, portfolio expansion, and net inflows and outflows.

  • Collaborate deeply across Marketing and Finance teams with regular touch points in Product and Tech, removing blockers and elevating the commercial execution engine.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years' experience in Revenue Ops, Sales Ops or similar roles, ideally in advisory-led, relationship-driven commercial models such as Wealth/Fintech, or SaaS environments

  • Clear communicator with a structured, ownership-driven, and pragmatic working style (full professional fluency required in both German and English)

  • Deep sales funnel and CRM expertise, especially HubSpot, plus practical experience with commercial tool stacks, (workflow) automation tools and process performance monitoring

  • Strong grasp of sales KPIs, funnel metrics, dashboard building, data visualization and process mapping; an analytically trained background is a strong plus (for example: consulting, controlling or FP&A)

  • Proven track record building forecast models and owning forecast accuracy over time, and building commercial operating infrastructure in a scaling organization

  • Operative mindset with cross-functional collaboration experience across Marketing, Sales, Relationship Management and the Management team: you steer change processes successfully without formal authority and hold sales and relationship management leadership accountable to process and data standards

  • First leadership experience, functional or disciplinary, and the ambition to take on a small team as the revenue organization grows.

What We Offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget of €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

 

What Happens Next

  • Introductory call: A short conversation with one of our recruiters to get to know you and share more about the role and team.

  • Interview with the hiring manager: A more profound discussion about your experience, leadership style, and operational expertise.

  • Case study: A practical task based on a real revenue operations challenge, followed by a joint discussion of your approach and recommendations.

  • Meet the team: Visit our Berlin office to get to know the people you will work closely with and get a real sense of our culture, ways of working, and shared ambition.

About Us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions: ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €3.8 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

data.title: VP/Head of Engineering (all genders)
data.description:
Your mission

Full technical ownership of Rocket — reporting directly to the founders, with no layer in between

In this role you own engineering at MICE DESK — fully. There is no CTO layer above you: architecture, technology, delivery, and team are yours, and you report directly to the founders. This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead the engineering team including our AI/Data function, own the interface to Product, and are accountable for everything that ships.

  • Engineering, end-to-end. Architecture, system design, delivery against the roadmap, reliability, technical debt. Backend, frontend, DevOps, QA, and the AI/Data team all roll up to you. You set lightweight processes that let a small team ship fast without breaking things.
  • An AI-enabled engineering pipeline. We don't just build AI products — we build with AI. You make the engineering organization itself AI-native: agentic coding workflows, AI-assisted review and testing, automation of everything repetitive. A small team should ship like one three times its size — making that true is your job.
  • AI as a core system capability. You architect the integration of LLMs and agentic workflows into production systems: deterministic logic combined with AI-generated outputs, with real validation, fallbacks, and reliability strategies. Hotel operations run on our platform — non-determinism is no excuse for unreliability.
  • The team. Hire, mentor, scale. You inherit a strong small team and grow it into a high-performance engineering organization with a culture of ownership and speed. Our distributed hiring strategy across multiple locations is yours as well.
  • Product and business alignment. You work directly with the founders and Product. You challenge requirements, simplify complexity, and connect engineering work to outcomes: revenue, automation, customer impact. As we enter the US market, engineering has to keep pace with enterprise-scale customers on two continents.

What success looks like:

  • 6 months: Delivery is predictable, the AI-enabled dev pipeline is running, and the team has grown with A-players you hired.
  • 12 months: The platform scales with US enterprise customers, core systems are reliable and observable, and engineering is a competitive advantage — not a bottleneck.

Honestly: This is full accountability with no net above it. No CTO layer to make or catch decisions — the architecture, the team, and everything that ships are yours. If you want a role where someone above you sets direction, this isn't it. If you want exactly that ownership, it is.


Your profile

  • 10+ years of software engineering, 5+ in an engineering leadership role at high-growth product companies.
  • Strong hands-on backend or full-stack background — you can still go deep.
  • Proven experience scaling engineering teams at growing startups.
  • Strong architecture expertise: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven design, cloud.
  • LLM / agentic AI systems in production — and genuine conviction that engineering itself should be AI-assisted.
  • Product mindset: you connect technical decisions to business outcomes.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and full accountability.

Nice to have, not required: Background in hospitality tech, CRM, PMS, or revenue management. Enterprise integration experience (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Experience leading distributed, international teams.


Why us?

We are the technology company rethinking group and event sales in hospitality. What runs today through inboxes, spreadsheets and phone calls, our platform Rocket turns into one continuous, AI-supported process — from the first enquiry to the signed contract. European hotel groups already run their group sales on it.
What that means for you: you work with AI, not despite it. People who join us give feedback that shapes product decisions — and sooner or later come to understand why one prompt works better than another.
And because we are growing fast, a lot here is still taking shape. Sometimes the honest answer is “we’re still building that.” That is exactly where the opportunity lies: you will find open space rather than finished structures, and what you build here will carry your signature.
What we offer

  • Work with real AI technology at international level — not as a pilot project, but as our business model.
  • Genuine room to shape things. Your ideas do not land in a suggestion box; they land in the next iteration.
  • A short path to the management team. Decisions take days, not committee rounds.
  • Growth you are part of. We are building the company’s next chapter — with roles, responsibility and prospects that did not exist a year ago.
  • Leipzig as your primary base, with regular time in the office and flexible remote work. Hybrid models are everyday practice here, not the exception.
  • Permanent contract, full-time.
  • Performance bonuses for demonstrable results.
  • Multi-day team events in places that are actually fun.
Our hiring process
  1. Intro interview — we get to know each other, and you learn where we stand and where we are heading.
  2. Leadership study or technical study, depending on the role — a real problem from our day-to-day that we work through together.
  3. Founder interview

data.title: UAV Operations Engineer / Pilot – Data Operations (all genders)
data.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.

We're focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe — today.


About the team

The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.


Your mission

You own our data-collection flights. When the perception team needs a specific dataset — a new camera at a new angle, a lidar over specific terrain, a thermal sensor at dusk — you plan the campaign, configure and tune the platform, fly the mission, and bring clean data home. Our hardware engineer builds the rigs and mounts, our robotics engineer makes the sensors record — you make it all fly, reliably, again and again. This is a role for someone with real stick time and real PX4/ArduPilot depth: not a desk job with occasional field trips, but the other way around.


Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute field data-collection campaigns across Europe: flight planning, site assessment, pre-flight checks, piloting, logging, and post-flight data offload

  • Configure, tune, and troubleshoot PX4/ArduPilot flight stacks for stable, repeatable data-collection flights

  • Analyze flight logs to diagnose issues and continuously improve platform reliability

  • Operate sensor payloads (cameras, gimbals, lidar, GNSS/IMU) during missions and verify recordings on-site

  • Keep the fleet mission-ready: maintenance, repairs, spare parts, battery management, and configuration control

  • Work with our hardware and robotics engineers on payload integration — you define what the platform needs to fly well

  • Maintain flight logs and campaign documentation so every flight produces usable, traceable data

  • Ensure operations comply with aviation regulations (EU drone rules) and internal safety procedures


Qualifications

  • Confident, experienced drone pilot with substantial real-world flight hours (multirotor; fixed-wing a plus), holding an EU A2/A3 certificate or willing to obtain quickly

  • Solid practical knowledge of PX4 and/or ArduPilot: configuration, parameter tuning, log analysis, MAVLink basics

  • Hands-on experience assembling, repairing, and maintaining drones — comfortable with soldering, wiring, and multimeter debugging

  • Experience operating sensor payloads and ground control stations in the field

  • Practical, structured, and safety-conscious — you find the loose cable before it becomes a crash

  • Willingness to travel regularly for field campaigns and work outdoors in various conditions

  • Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)


Nice to have

  • Scripting skills (Python, Bash) for flight log processing and data offload automation

  • CAD basics (Fusion 360, SolidWorks) and 3D-printing experience

  • Experience with ROS/ROS2 recording setups or companion computers (Jetson, Raspberry Pi)

  • Background in FPV, drone racing, RC modeling, competition teams, or maker culture

  • Experience with camera settings and image quality trade-offs for data collection

  • German driving license class B (field campaigns)

    A note on our process: a portfolio says more than a CV here. Show us your builds and your flights — photos, flight logs, competition entries. If you don't hit every bullet point but you have been flying and fixing drones for years, we still want to hear from you.
    If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, please send us your CV and portfolio in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

data.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution.


Your mission

You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Translate Needs: Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team.

  • Push the Backlog: Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones.

  • Drive Execution: Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly.

  • Document Capabilities: Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver.

  • Evaluate & Accept Work: Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms.

  • Technical Literacy: You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers.

  • Systems Thinking: A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers.


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration.

  • Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context.

  • Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors.

data.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.


We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.


About the team

As a Datalink Integration & Test Engineer , you will play a key role in bringing together complex software systems that power our next generation of autonomous platforms. 


Your mission

Your mission is to take established, proven MANET (mobile ad-hoc network) radio systems and make them work — reliably, repeatably, and under real-world constraints — inside our unmanned platforms. In this role you focus on the datalinks for our close- and short-range loitering effector and ISR systems, where the link has to stay solid through fast-moving, time-critical mission profiles in contested airspace. You own the path from "commercial radio in a box" to "integrated, tested, mission-ready datalink."

This is a hands-on integration and test role at the boundary of RF hardware, networking, and platform architecture. You own two connections that have to hold up when it counts: the command-and-control link between UAV and ground control station (GCS), and the mesh that lets multiple effectors operate as a coordinated swarm. You aren't just wiring in a radio; you are certifying that command and control survives contact with the real world, and giving the engineering team the hard data to trust it.


Responsibilities

Integration

  • Integrate established MANET / mesh radio systems (e.g., Silvus StreamCaster, Persistent Systems Wave Relay, Rajant, Radionor) into STARK's platform architecture across the mechanical, power, RF, and network/software interfaces.
  • Define and implement the integration approach for each datalink — antenna placement, RF front-end, IP networking, and interfacing with the autopilot and payload stack.
  • Integrate and configure the UAV-to-GCS command-and-control link, ensuring reliable telemetry, control, and video across the full mission profile through to the terminal phase.
  • Set up and tune multi-node mesh topologies that enable UAV-to-UAV connectivity and coordinated swarm operation of multiple effectors, including relay and self-healing behaviour.
  • Work closely with hardware, autopilot, and systems engineering to ensure the communication subsystem is correctly matched to the platform and its constraints.
Test & Validation
  • Design and execute structured test campaigns — bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and field trials — to validate datalink behaviour.
  • Characterise link performance across throughput, latency, range, mesh routing behaviour, and resilience under interference and degraded conditions.
  • Validate swarm behaviour at the network level — multi-node mesh scaling, UAV-to-UAV and UAV-to-GCS connectivity, relay hops, and graceful degradation as nodes join, move, or drop out.
  • Build up repeatable test procedures and instrumentation, and produce clear, traceable documentation of setups, methods, and results.
Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  • Translate field and test findings into concrete integration and configuration improvements.
  • Support trade-offs and selection decisions between candidate datalink systems with measured, defensible data.
  • Contribute to the evolution of STARK's communication integration standards and test methodology.


Qualifications

Experience & Certifications

  • Professional background in Electronics / Communications Engineering or a comparable technical field.
  • Hands-on experience integrating MANET / mesh radio or tactical datalink systems into a larger platform or system.
  • Practical test and measurement experience (spectrum analysers, RF link testing, network diagnostics).
  • Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).
Technical Background
  • Solid grounding in RF fundamentals and antenna/propagation basics.
  • Strong understanding of IP networking, routing, and the OSI model as it applies to mesh and point-to-point links.
  • Comfortable working in Linux networking environments and debugging at the hardware/software boundary.
  • Structured, disciplined approach to test design, execution, and documentation.
Profile
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Analytical, thorough, and outcome-oriented — you want the integration to be clean and the results to hold up, not just to work once.


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with specific MANET vendor ecosystems and their management/config tooling.
  • Knowledge of tactical datalink bands, waveforms, FHSS, and encryption.
  • Familiarity with military communication standards and secure over-the-air transmission.
  • Scripting / embedded experience (Python, C++) for test automation and instrumentation.

data.title: Battery System Engineer/Architect (all genders)
data.description:
About Us

STARK is a European defence technology company building the next generation of unmanned systems. We design, develop and manufacture software-defined, mass-scalable and cost-effective platforms that give NATO operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance capability — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, our work strengthens the technological edge of NATO Allies and their partners.


Your mission

As a Battery System Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, development, and integration of high-performance battery packs for our fleet of drones. Because every gram and watt matters in aviation, you will focus heavily on optimizing for Size, Weight, and Power while ensuring uncompromising safety, thermal stability, and cycle life. You will work cross-functionally with mechanical, firmware, and aerospace engineers to seamlessly integrate the battery system into our application.


Responsibilities

  • System Design & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of bespoke battery packs tailored to the high-discharge and strict weight requirements of UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles).
  • BMS Integration: Work closely with firmware and electronics teams to define requirements for Battery Management Systems (BMS), including state-of-charge (SOC) and state-of-health (SOH) algorithms, cell balancing, and fault protection logic.
  • Thermal & Mechanical Management: Collaborate with mechanical engineers to design lightweight enclosures and thermal mitigation strategies that prevent overheating during peak flight loads.
  • Testing & Validation: Develop rigorous test plans for battery packs at the cell, module, and pack levels using testing equipment. Conduct thermal runaway, drop, vibration, and environmental testing.
  • Compliance & Safety: Ensure all battery designs meet relevant international safety and transport standards (e.g., UN 38.3).
  • Manufacturing Support: Partner with supply chain and external contract manufacturers to transition designs from prototype to mass production, ensuring high yield and quality control.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in battery system design, preferably in aerospace, automotive (EV), or consumer electronics

Technical Skills:
  • Deep understanding of lithium-based battery chemistries, failure modes, and degradation mechanisms.
  • Experience with BMS architecture, cell monitoring, and protection circuitry.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (e.g.,Catia) and PCB design/review tools (e.g., Altium).
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, I2C, and UART.

  • Hardware Experience: Hands-on experience building prototypes, soldering, and using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, electronic loads, battery cyclers).


Nice to have

data.title: Research Data Manager (PostDoc) for mapping harvesting relationships (KTS-84)
data.description:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on October 1, 2026 our Department Knowledge Technologies for the Social Sciences (KTS), Team FAIR Data located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Research Data Manager (PostDoc) for mapping harvesting relationships
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 100 %, limited for three years)
 
The department Knowledge Technologies for Social Sciences (KTS) conducts research at the intersection of information retrieval, natural language processing, semantic technologies and human information interaction as foundation for innovative web portals and platforms for the search and use of research data. 

The HaFER project’s goal is to improve the visibility of German research data by identifying how metadata is propagated between the many services collecting such data. For this, we will build a map that will identify which data services harvest which metadata, and how metadata are transformed in the process. Based on this map we will offer best practices to the data services, negotiate with harvesters on how to present metadata better. The positions requires both networking capabilities within the relevant communities as well as technical skills to wrangle, model and analyze the metadata. 

 


Your tasks will be:

  • Managing and coordinating the HaFER project to make it a success 
  • Setting-up automated systems for metadata collection with the help of AI tools
  • Networking within the NFDI and other research data organizations to help promote the goals of HaFER, including organization of networking events
  • Conducting research in the topics of the department


Your profile:

  • Completed academic university degree (Master’s or equivalent) and completed PhD in Computer Science, Social Science or related subjects
  • Experience in Research Data Management, for example in the context of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI), or with services that harvest research metadata
  • Experience in handling, curating, harvesting and/or extracting research metadata on a technical level
  • Proven research record in the topics of the department, preferably Knowledge Graphs and/or Information Extraction
  • Excellent English skills are a must, German language skills are a plus


Our Benefits:

  • Aktives Sourcing ist ein großer Teil der Rolle. Du identifizierst die Profile, die wir suchen, sprichst sie direkt an und überzeugst sie von einem Wechsel, über den sie vorher nicht nachgedacht haben. Recherche, Longlists und Ansprache gehören dir.

  • Auf der Inbound-Seite verantwortest du die eingehenden Bewerbungen, von der Sichtung über die Erstgespräche bis zur Rückmeldung. Nach jeder Veröffentlichung kommt in den ersten Tagen das meiste Volumen, und wer schnell reagiert, führt die besten Gespräche zuerst.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Hiring Managern zusammen: Anforderungsprofil gemeinsam schärfen, bevor die erste Sichtung läuft, Bewertungskriterien vorab festlegen, Debriefs moderieren. Wo ein Interview-Loop besser laufen kann, schlägst du Änderungen vor und setzt sie um

  • Du legst fest, woran wir Recruiting messen. Du entscheidest mit, welche Zahlen wir brauchen, erhebst sie und reportest sie regelmäßig. Wenn eine Suche nicht läuft, sagst du früh Bescheid und kannst erklären, woran es liegt.

  • Für deine Rollen gehört dir unser Ashby-Setup, von der Pipeline-Pflege über Templates und Interview-Guides bis zum Reporting.

  • Du hältst den Prozess auf dem Tempo, das wir versprechen. Wir schreiben unter zwei Wochen in unsere Anzeigen, und Kandidat:innen verlassen sich darauf.

Was wir nicht suchen

  • Menschen, die auf ein Briefing warten, bevor sie anfangen.

  • Wer Recruiting vor allem als Weiterleiten von Lebensläufen versteht.

  • Wer dem Hiring Manager nicht widerspricht, wenn das Anforderungsprofil nicht zum Markt passt.

Dein Profil

Du musst nicht alles davon mitbringen. Die ersten drei Punkte sind die wichtigsten.

  • Du hast in-house über den kompletten Zyklus rekrutiert und Kandidat:innen selbst zum Abschluss gebracht. Wenn du aus einer Agentur kommst und danach in-house gewechselt bist, passt das genauso.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und gutes Englisch (B2+). Ein Teil unserer Kandidat:innen ist ausschließlich deutschsprachig.

  • Du sourcst selbst und kannst uns im Gespräch zeigen, wie du an eine schwierige Suche herangehst: Suchlogik, Ansprache, und was dabei zurückkommt.

  • Du schaust dir die Zahlen deines Funnels an und weißt, an welcher Stelle du den größten Hebel hast.

  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI-Tools und automatisierst damit die wiederkehrenden Teile deiner Arbeit.

  • Du schreibst gut. Eine Erstansprache, auf die auch jemand antwortet, der gerade nicht sucht, und Absagen, nach denen Kandidat:innen sich später wieder bei uns melden.

Das macht dich aus

  • Du hast quer über sehr unterschiedliche Funktionen rekrutiert und wechselst schnell zwischen ihnen. Bei uns läuft in derselben Woche eine Suche in der Lohnbuchhaltung, eine im AI Engineering und eine im Vertrieb, und alle drei brauchen eine andere Ansprache.

  • Du hast Structured Hiring in einem Unternehmen eingeführt, das vorher ohne gearbeitet hat.

  • Du hast ein ATS wie Ashby oder Greenhouse selbst aufgesetzt und gepflegt.

  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen zwischen Seed und Series B.

Prozess

Wir bewegen uns schnell. Für die richtige Person dauert der gesamte Prozess weniger als zwei Wochen.

  1. Virtuelles Kennenlernen mit uns

  2. Virtuelles Fachgespräch mit unserem Chief of Staff

  3. Einladung in unser Office: Case Study auf einer echten offenen Rolle von uns, dazu Team und Produkt kennenlernen

Unser Angebot

  • Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt

  • Erster Hire im Talent Team, mit entsprechendem Einfluss darauf, wie wir künftig einstellen

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: kein Filter, keine Warteschlange, kein Komitee

  • Die besten AI-Tools: Claude Max, Cursor, OpenAI, was auch immer nächste Woche erscheint

  • 28 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus halbe Tage am 24. und 31. Dezember

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge zu über 200 Partnern oder Deutschlandticket, deine Wahl

  • Moderne Ausstattung inkl. MacBook

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV)

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen von Berlin Prenzlauer Berg, direkt neben dem Mauerpark

  • Wöchentliche Teamlunches, Büro-BBQs und ein Dinnerbudget für späte Abende nach 20 Uhr

  • Ein Team von 50+ (und wachsend) ambitionierten, diversen Menschen, 20%+ Ex-Gründer:innen, die gemeinsam lernen und bauen

Auch wenn du nicht jeden Punkt abdeckst, die Rolle und das Umfeld dich aber reizen: bewirb dich. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und stellen Menschen aufgrund ihrer Fähigkeit ein, eine Aufgabe zu erfüllen. Menschen jeder Herkunft, jeden Geschlechts, jeder geschlechtlichen Identität, sexuellen Orientierung, Religion, jeden Alters, mit Behinderung, jeder politischen Überzeugung oder jedem Familienstand sind bei Integral willkommen.

data.title: Controller Kalkulation & Business Performance (m/w/d)
data.description:
Merch my Day ist mehr als nur Merchandise – wir erschaffen Marken. Als junges, wachsendes Unternehmen mit Fokus auf hochwertigem Brand-Merch für Künstler, Unternehmen und Persönlichkeiten verbinden wir kreative Visionen mit smartem E-Commerce.

Und weil Wachstum nicht nur Kreativität, sondern auch Transparenz und gute Entscheidungen braucht, wollen wir unser Controlling auf das nächste Level bringen und suchen ab sofort einen

Aufgaben

  • Kalkulation & Pricing: Du erstellst Vor- und Nachkalkulationen für Angebote, Aufträge und Projekte, prüfst Margen und entwickelst Kalkulationsschemata, Kostensätze und Preise weiter.
  • Business Controlling: Du analysierst Deckungsbeiträge und Wirtschaftlichkeit unserer Geschäftsfelder, verantwortest Budget & Forecast und behältst Soll-Ist-Abweichungen, Bestände und Working Capital im Blick.
  • Reporting & Insights: Du entwickelst unser Managementreporting und relevante KPIs weiter, führst Ad-hoc-Analysen durch und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Strukturen & Daten: Du entwickelst unsere Kostenstellen- und Kostenträgerstruktur sowie Controlling-Prozesse weiter und sorgst für eine verlässliche Datenbasis über unsere verschiedenen Systeme hinweg.
  • Business Partnering: Du arbeitest eng mit Finance, Sales, Projektmanagement und Geschäftsführung zusammen und schaffst die wirtschaftliche Transparenz für fundierte Entscheidungen.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast relevante Erfahrung im Controlling, Business Controlling, Projektcontrolling, Commercial Controlling oder in der Kalkulation.
  • Du verstehst Kostenstrukturen, Margen und Deckungsbeiträge und kannst daraus wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge ableiten.
  • Vor- und Nachkalkulationen sowie Soll-Ist-Analysen sind für dich vertrautes Terrain.
  • Du bist sehr sicher im Umgang mit Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch größere Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren.
  • Du hast idealerweise bereits mit ERP-, Warenwirtschafts-, Finance- oder BI-Systemen gearbeitet.
  • Du hast Spaß daran, Strukturen aufzubauen, statt nur bestehende Prozesse abzuarbeiten.
  • Du bist analytisch stark, gleichzeitig aber pragmatisch genug, aus einer Analyse auch eine Entscheidung zu machen.
  • Du kannst komplexe Zahlen so aufbereiten, dass auch Menschen ohne Controlling-Hintergrund sofort verstehen, worum es geht.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch.
  • Und du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem Fashion, Merch, Musik, Produktion, E-Commerce und Business zusammenkommen.

Kein Muss – aber definitiv ein Plus:

  • Erfahrung in einem projekt-, produktions- oder handelsnahen Umfeld
  • Verständnis für Warenbestände, Einkauf, Produktion und Supply Chain
  • Erfahrung mit Pricing und Angebotskalkulation
  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau von KPI- oder Management-Reporting
  • Kenntnisse in BI-Tools oder Datenvisualisierung
  • Interesse an Automatisierung und daran, wie AI Controlling-Prozesse smarter machen kann

Benefits

Bei uns übernimmst du keine Rolle, in der du einmal im Monat Zahlen zusammenträgst und Reports verschickst.

Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, die wirtschaftliche Steuerung eines wachsenden Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

Du arbeitest nah an Projekten, Produkten und Entscheidungen – und siehst unmittelbar, welchen Unterschied deine Arbeit macht.

Deine Analysen landen nicht in der Schublade. Sie verändern, wie wir kalkulieren, entscheiden und wachsen.

Und gleichzeitig arbeitest du in einem Umfeld, in dem Fashion, Musik, Artists, Brands, Produktion und E-Commerce zusammenkommen.

Zahlen sind für dich nicht nur Reporting, sondern die Grundlage für gute Entscheidungen? Du willst verstehen, was hinter Projekten, Preisen und Margen steckt – und Strukturen schaffen, mit denen ein wachsendes Unternehmen noch besser gesteuert werden kann? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

data.description:
Your mission

Bright Capital is looking to hire a (Senior) Investment Associate (f/m/d) for its Frankfurt office to strengthen its private debt investment team, focusing on the European lower mid-market. Our strategy centres on non-sponsored direct lending, with a particular focus on independent sponsor-backed buy-and-build platforms, underpinned by a highly flexible investment approach. This role offers exposure to a broad and varied range of transaction structures and opportunities. You will support the investment team across the entire investment lifecycle. You will work closely with senior management while also taking on individual responsibilities in executing transactions and managing existing investments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Origination & Execution: Source, evaluate and execute private debt investment opportunities primarily across the DACH region, alongside selective opportunities across Western Europe, including the Benelux, Nordics and UK
  • Financial Analysis: Develop and maintain financial models, perform valuation, sensitivity and scenario analyses, and assess the financial performance, credit profile and investment merits of prospective transactions
  • Due Diligence & Structuring: Coordinate and evaluate financial, commercial, legal and tax due diligence workstreams, support transaction structuring, and assist in the negotiation of key legal documentation

Your profile

We are looking for an individual with excellent technical and modelling competencies, an entrepreneurial attitude, and great German market knowledge as well as language skills to join our investment team.

data.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
data.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. 

We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
  • Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
  • Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
  • Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
  • Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:
  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
  • Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.


What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.


What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.

  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.

  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).

  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.

  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

data.description:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Financial Controller to join our team on a part-time basis (50%). Reporting directly to executive management, your mission is to build and professionalize our controlling function from the ground up across all our entities. In this key role, you will take full ownership of shaping our financial backbone: Steering financial planning and analysis, building automated KPI visibility, and bridging operational accounting with strategic decision-making. Additionally, you will serve as the central liaison to our external accounting partners, ensuring smooth daily operations and seamless year-end closings for our consultancy. 


What You'll Own

  • Controlling Infrastructure: Design, implement, and professionalize our entire controlling and reporting structures from scratch.

  • Multi-Entity Management: Oversee, align, and consolidate financial operations and reporting across all three corporate entities (Germany, Switzerland, and Lithuania).

  • Dashboarding & Reporting: Build and maintain automated dashboards covering key KPIs across all major business areas, defined in close alignment with management, to ensure timely and regular visibility into business performance.

  • Strategic Sparring: Serve as a trusted advisor to management, providing data-driven input for key financial and strategic decisions.

  • Daily Financial Operations: Oversee day-to-day accounting tasks, including processing incoming invoices, managing accounts payable/receivable, and executing timely payments.

  • Accounting Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact and coordinate seamlessly with our external accounting firm (tax advisors/bookkeepers).

  • Year-End Closings: Manage and accompany the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements (Jahresabschluss).

  • Financial Planning & Analysis: Develop comprehensive financial models, forecasting, and budget planning to support strategic decision-making.

  • Process Optimization: Drive continuous improvements across finance and administrative functions to increase efficiency and scalability.


What You Bring

  • Proven track record (3-5+ years) in Financial Controlling, ideally within a consultancy, agency, or tech-driven environment.

  • A proactive, hands-on mindset with the ability to work highly independently in a dynamic boutique consultancy environment.

  • Solid understanding of accounting principles (e.g., HGB) and hands-on experience accompanying year-end closings in a multi-entity environment.

  • Strong analytical skills, critical thinking, and the confidence to take full ownership of the finance function.

  • Proficiency in modern financial software (we use Finway), and advanced Excel skills.

What We Offer

  • Mehr Freizeit

Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen.
  • Exklusive Deals & Extras
    It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen:
  • Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst.
  • Mobiko – 65 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget, nutzbar für Deutschlandticket, Tankkosten und alles, was kostet, um von A nach B zu kommen.

data.title: DevOps Engineer AWS & Kubernetes, Junior/Intermediate (m/w/d)
data.description:
Remote (Deutschland) · Angestellte/r · DevOps / Cloud

DevOps Engineer AWS & Kubernetes, Junior/Intermediate (m/w/d), Remote, Vollzeit, ab Anfang September.

Für unser sympathisches Team suchen wir deutschsprachige DevOps Engineers (m/w/d) auf Junior- oder Intermediate-Level, die in unserem Kundenprojekt den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung einer geschäftskritischen Plattform in der AWS Cloud mittragen.

New Monday ist eine Digitalagentur aus Berlin, die zu 100% remote arbeitet. Zu unseren Kunden zählen namhafte Konzerne wie Atruvia, DAK, SAP, Lufthansa uvm. genau wie moderne Start-Ups wie NUMA Stays.

Als Arbeitgeber zeichnen wir uns vor allem durch flache Hierarchien, unser agiles Mindset und einen New Work Approach aus. Alle unsere New Monday Team Members arbeiten zu 100% remote (Home Office), sind dank unserer positiven Remote Culture aber trotzdem miteinander verbunden (erfahre mehr darüber im Abschnitt "Benefits").

Zum Projekt: Die Anwendung ist die zentrale Plattform für die Planung und Steuerung der Abläufe in den 10 Werken eines großen deutschen Mobilitätskonzerns. Aktuell wird ein DevOps-Team aufgebaut, bestehend aus den vorhandenen Betriebsspezialisten und zentralen Entwicklern der drei Entwicklungsteams, um Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb langfristig sicherzustellen. Die Anwendung läuft derzeit im SLA Bronze; ab Ende des zweiten Quartals 2027 soll SLA Gold möglich sein, da dann die Disposition in den Betrieb geht. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit und Betriebsstabilität steigen also messbar, und genau daran arbeitest du mit.

Aufgaben

  • Betrieb, Überwachung und technische Betreuung der produktiven Anwendung und der zugehörigen Infrastruktur in der AWS Cloud, inklusive Analyse und Bearbeitung auftretender Fehler und Störungen.
  • Bearbeitung von Security Findings sowie Durchführung erforderlicher Patch- und Aktualisierungsmaßnahmen.
  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der automatisierten Bereitstellung und Konfiguration der Umgebungen mit Terraform bzw. OpenTofu.
  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Kubernetes-Cluster und der zugehörigen Infrastrukturkonfigurationen, inklusive Optimierung des automatisierten Node-Scalings mit Karpenter.
  • Unterstützung bei Bereitstellung und Deployment containerisierter Anwendungen auf Basis von Docker, Helm und Flux sowie Analyse und Behebung von Problemen in Deployments und Release-Prozessen.
  • Betreuung und Konfiguration von AWS IAM-Rollen und Berechtigungen sowie Einrichtung und Verwaltung von Secrets und Verschlüsselung mit AWS Secrets Manager und AWS KMS.
  • Unterstützung bei der Anbindung und Konfiguration von PostgreSQL-Datenbanken auf Basis von AWS RDS.
  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Monitoring- und Logging-Lösungen auf Basis von Grafana und OpenSearch.
  • Betreuung und Konfiguration der Kafka-Infrastruktur auf Basis von Amazon MSK Serverless.
  • Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Dependency- und Update-Prozesse mit Renovate.
  • Entwicklung, Anpassung und Betreuung von AWS-Lambda-Funktionen auf Basis von Python.
  • Konsolidierung und technische Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Infrastruktur sowie Analyse technischer Probleme rund um Infrastruktur, Deployment, IAM, Datenbankanbindungen und Secrets.
  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Betriebsdokumentation, insbesondere Runbooks, Betriebsprozesse und Handlungsanweisungen.
  • Mitwirkung bei der Standardisierung und Automatisierung wiederkehrender Betriebsabläufe und bei der Vorbereitung der Anwendung auf erhöhte Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit und Betriebsstabilität.

Qualifikation

Must-have:

  • Erfahrung im operativen Betrieb produktiver IT-Anwendungen in Cloud-Infrastrukturen.
  • Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Administration von AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen.
  • Erfahrung mit Kubernetes als Containerplattform zur Bereitstellung und Verwaltung containerisierter Anwendungen.
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform oder OpenTofu.
  • Erfahrung im Betrieb geschäftskritischer Anwendungen mit etablierten Incident-Management-Prozessen.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Projektsprache ist Deutsch).
  • Verfügbarkeit ab Anfang September.

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung mit Docker, Helm und GitOps-Ansätzen.
  • Monitoring, Logging und technische Fehleranalyse.
  • AWS Cloud Security, z. B. IAM, Secrets, Verschlüsselung.
  • Erfahrung im IT-Betriebsmanagement.
  • Deployment- und Release-Automatisierung.

Benefits

  • Tolle Leute, super Atmosphäre, dynamisches Team, agile Arbeitsweise
  • Sweet Spot zwischen Corporate-Alltag und kreativem Agenturleben: Bei uns musst du nicht zwischen hunderten Projekten gleichzeitig jonglieren, sondern bist immer nur für ein einzelnes Projekt eingeteilt.
  • Die Möglichkeit, deutschlandweit ortsunabhängig zu arbeiten, wo immer du möchtest (100% Home Office) sowie im Rahmen der rechtlichen Vorgaben zeitweise auch im EU-Ausland
  • Monatliches Budget für Treffen vor Ort mit deinen Kolleg:innen, das du beliebig einsetzen kannst (Teamtage im Co-Working-Space aber genauso auch einfach für den gemeinsamen Lunch, Dinner, After-Work-Drinks etc.)
  • Regelmäßige digitale Teamabende und andere coole digitale Events
  • Treffen vor Ort mit dem ganzen Team in unserem inoffiziellen Hub Berlin ein- bis zweimal pro Jahr
  • Wöchentliche Learning Sessions im Team und weitere Möglichkeiten zu deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung (Weiterbildungen, Erwerb von Zertifikaten etc.)
  • Eigenständiges, flexibles Arbeiten ohne Micromanagement

Erstes Kennenlernen Du lernst unsere Arbeitsweise und Philosophie kennen. Du hast die Gelegenheit, dich vorzustellen. Wir beantworten alle deine Fragen in entspannter Atmosphäre.

Vorstellungsgespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti Ausführlicheres Kennenlernen. Gelegenheit zu gegenseitigen Fragen.

Follow-Up Hierzu erhältst du vorab eine kleine technische Challenge, in der du zeigen kannst, wie du an Aufgaben herangehst. Die Ergebnisse besprechen wir gemeinsam im Follow-Up. Du hast anschließend die Möglichkeit, ein Gespräch unter vier Augen mit einem deiner zukünftigen Kolleg:innen zu führen und in vertrauensvoller Atmosphäre all das zu fragen, was dir vielleicht noch auf der Seele brennt.

Also los geht's! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Um es einfach zu halten, verzichten wir gerne auf ein Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, auch wenn du das Gefühl hast, nicht 100 % der Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

New Monday fördert aktiv die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir begrüßen daher alle Bewerber:innen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer, kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Identität der Person. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung aller Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

data.description:
Your nails. Your creativity. Your camera.

Are you a passionate Nail Tech who knows the difference between Builder Gel and Polyacryl, can execute a flawless Russian Manicure, and gets excited about creating the perfect Nail Art?

And do you also love creating content, explaining techniques, filming tutorials and showing your personality on camera?

Then we want to hear from you.

We are looking for a Nail Tech & Content Creator to join our team and become one of the faces and technical experts behind our nail content.

You won't just create beautiful nails. You'll show our community how to create them.

Aufgaben

Your responsibilities

💅 Nail Tech Expertise

You will be our technical nail expert, creating professional nail looks and demonstrating our products across different techniques and levels of expertise.

Your work will include:

  • Classic Gel Polish / gel manicure
  • Soft Gel Nail Tips / Full Cover Tips
  • Builder Gel / BIAB
  • Polyacryl / Polygel
  • Acrylic
  • Popits / Dual Forms
  • Russian Manicure – this is particularly important to us
  • Nail extensions and refills
  • Nail Art and creative techniques
  • Professional nail preparation
  • Different nail shapes and structures
  • Clean, precise and technically correct application

🎥 Content Creation

You will create engaging content for Instagram, TikTok and other social platforms.

This includes:

  • Short-form videos and Reels
  • Full step-by-step tutorials
  • Educational content
  • Product demonstrations
  • Nail transformations
  • Nail Art content
  • Trend-based content
  • Tips, tricks and professional techniques
  • Before & after content

You won't just demonstrate a technique – you'll explain it clearly and make people want to try it themselves.

🎬 Be the face of our content

You are comfortable being on camera and showing your personality.

You don't need to be a professional presenter. Authenticity, personality and confidence are more important to us.

💡 Content & Product Development

You will work closely with our Marketing and Product teams to:

  • Develop new content formats
  • Test and review products
  • Provide professional technical feedback
  • Identify new nail trends
  • Create new nail looks
  • Turn customer questions and trends into useful content

Qualifikation

What we're looking for

Nail expertise

You have strong professional Nail Tech skills and are comfortable working across multiple techniques.

Russian Manicure is particularly important for this position.

You have a strong understanding of nail preparation, product application, structure, shaping and overall nail health.

Most importantly, you have high technical standards and an eye for detail.

Experience with video editing is a plus, but you don't need to be a professional videographer.

Personality

You are creative, curious, reliable and hands-on.

You enjoy experimenting with new techniques and trends, but you also care about technical quality.

You're someone who can look at a nail trend and think:

"I know exactly how we could make this into great content."

Benefits

What we offer

data.description:
🚀 Globalist ist DIE führende Performance-Marketing-Agentur für nationale und internationale digitale Marketingstrategien, made in Stuttgart!

Unsere Agentur ist in Paid Search, Paid Social und Organic Search unterteilt und betreut bereits über 370 Kunden. Wir verwalten jährlich 60 Mio. € Werbebudget und kombinieren Strategie mit operativer Skalierungsexpertise. Dank direkter Google- und Meta-Schulungen setzen wir auf moderne, datengetriebene Performance-Optimierung.

Zu unseren Kunden gehören Boehringer Ingelheim, La Marzocco, Nø Cosmetics, ASAM BEAUTY und viele mehr!

Was uns unterscheidet: Unser Herz schlägt für den eCommerce. Wir betreuen nicht nur Top-Brands, sondern betreiben auch eigene eCommerce-Shops. Das bedeutet, du kannst dich über das reine Design hinaus in Bereichen wie Nutzerforschung, datengetriebene Optimierung und Shopify-Ökosysteme weiterentwickeln und die Ergebnisse deiner Arbeit direkt an echten Umsatzzahlen messen.

Aufgaben

Als CRO Manager bei Globalist optimierst du E-Commerce-Shops so, dass aus Besuchern Käufer werden – datenbasiert, hypothesengetrieben und mit direktem Impact auf den Umsatz unserer Kunden. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Daten, Design und Entwicklung und steuerst CRO-Projekte von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.

Das erwartet dich konkret bei uns:

  • Du analysierst Conversion Funnels, Nutzerverhalten und Shop-Performance unserer E-Commerce-Kunden mit GA4, Heatmap-Tools und Session Recordings – und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungshypothesen ab.
  • Du konzipierst A/B-Tests und Personalisierungsmaßnahmen, priorisierst sie nach Uplift-Potenzial und begleitest den gesamten Testing-Prozess bis zur statistisch validen Auswertung.
  • Du übernimmst das Stakeholder Management gegenüber unseren Kunden: Du präsentierst Testergebnisse, erklärst komplexe CRO-Zusammenhänge verständlich und leitest klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Du erstellst Wireframes und klickbare Prototypen in Figma, um Optimierungsideen schnell greifbar zu machen – für Kunden, Entwickler und interne Teams.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Webentwicklern zusammen und bringst grundlegendes technisches Verständnis (HTML/CSS, JavaScript-Basics) mit, um Umsetzungen zu begleiten und zu prüfen.
  • Du arbeitest crossfunktional mit unseren SEA-, Paid-Social- und SEO-Teams, um kanalübergreifende Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren und gemeinsam zu heben.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit (Muss):

  • 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich CRO, E-Commerce oder UX – idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem E-Commerce-Unternehmen
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im E-Commerce: Du kennst typische Funnel-Strukturen, weißt, wo Shops verlieren und was Conversion-Hebel im Online-Handel sind
  • Sicheres Stakeholder Management: Du kannst Testergebnisse und Optimierungsstrategien gegenüber Kunden klar kommunizieren und überzeugend vertreten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma – du kannst Hypothesen in Wireframes und Prototypen übersetzen, ohne auf Entwickler warten zu müssen
  • Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis (HTML/CSS, JavaScript-Basics), um mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren und Implementierungen zu prüfen
  • Erfahrung mit A/B-Testing-Tools (z.B. VWO, Optimizely, AB Tasty) und Google Analytics / GA4
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C1) für die direkte Kundenberatung

Das wäre das Sahnehäubchen (Kann):

  • Erfahrung mit Heatmap- und Session-Recording-Tools wie Hotjar oder Microsoft Clarity
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify, Shopware oder anderen E-Commerce-Systemen
  • Interesse an AI-gestützter Optimierung und GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

Benefits

Bei Globalist arbeitest du in einem crossfunktionalen Team, das Performance nicht nur für Kunden denkt, sondern auch für sich selbst lebt. CRO ist bei uns kein Silo – du arbeitest täglich mit SEA-, SEO- und Paid-Social-Experten zusammen und profitierst von einem breiten Wissenspool. Learnings werden offen geteilt, Testergebnisse gemeinsam gefeiert. Unsere eigenen E-Com-Brands im Fashion- und Outdoor-Bereich dienen dir als Playground: Neue Hypothesen testen, bevor sie auf Kundenprojekte skaliert werden.
